validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE — real and well-corroborated. The gem.wiki page rests on a SINGLE citation (offshore-technology.com Salman-field article, backlinks=7 covering every data point), which is an existence risk on its own, but independent sources confirm the pipeline: (1) offshore-technology.com — 'A 147km-long subsea pipeline connected the field to the natural gas liquids (NGL) plant in Siri Island... in 2013'; (2) mizenaft.ir (fa) — '~160 MMcf/d of Salman-field gas is extracted via the KPP platform and transferred through a 30-inch pipeline 145 km long to Sirri Island'; (3) iranoilgas.com — 'sub-sea gas pipeline from Salman gas field to Sirri Island and then to the Fourth Refinery of South Pars Gas Complex at Assaluyeh'; (4) DMS Universe — 'IOOC - Salman - Sirri Gas Pipeline', Salman field ~144 km S of Lavan Island. STATUS operating: confirmed (line in service, damaged/repaired per iranoilgas, ongoing operation per mizenaft) — tier high. FUEL gas: confirmed (associated/field gas). LENGTH 147 km: offshore-technology gives 147, mizenaft gives 145 — two independent sources agree within ~1% (GEM's 147 matches offshore-technology exactly) — tier high, minor caveat on the 145 vs 147 spread. DIAMETER 30 in: mizenaft (30-inch) + GulfPub (30.0) agree — tier high. START YEAR 2013: offshore-technology explicit — tier high (Sirri NGL plant commissioned 2013). NOT A DUPLICATE: distinct spoke of the Siri Island hub — P3949 (Siri–Asaluyeh, 289/313 km, the onward 32-in line) and P3951 (Siri–Mobarak, 66 km) are the other spokes; Salman–Siri is the feed line from the Salman field. GulfPub 'Salman - Sirri Island Pipeline' (30 in, len 91 km — GulfPub length is low/straight-line) is the SAME physical pipe, not a separate GEM row. CLASSIFICATION: it is a genuine offshore gas transmission/feed line (Salman field → Siri NGL plant → Assaluyeh), within GGIT scope — not gathering-internal, not oil/condensate (the oil from Salman goes to Lavan on a separate 22-in line).

validity.recommendation: Change StartLocation from 'Lavan Island' to the Salman field / KPP production platform. Keep EndLocation = Siri Island. StartState/Province is offshore Persian Gulf (not a land province).
validity.researcher_notes: START ENDPOINT WRONG. GEM has StartLocation='Lavan Island' → Siri Island. But every independent source runs the 147 km gas line from the SALMAN FIELD (KPP platform), NOT Lavan: offshore-technology ('connected the field to the NGL plant in Siri Island'), mizenaft ('gas... extracted via the KPP platform and transferred... to Sirri Island'), iranoilgas ('from Salman gas field to Sirri Island'), DMS Universe (Salman field ~144 km S of Lavan). Lavan Island is where Salman's OIL goes, via a SEPARATE 22-in subsea line (offshore-technology: 'transported to the onshore processing facilities at Lavan Island via a 22in subsea pipeline'). GEM has conflated the oil-to-Lavan line with the gas-to-Siri line. FuelSource='Salman Oil & Gas Field' is correct and is itself the tell that the start should be the field, not Lavan. Real pipe, correctly classified — hence caveat not concern — but the start endpoint should be corrected to the Salman field/KPP platform.

validity.recommendation: Replace the broken/incorrect Owner ref (ioec.com — that is IOEC, the EPC contractor, not the owner) with a valid source. Owner 'National Iranian Oil Co' is defensible at the parent level; the operating subsidiary is IOOC (Iranian Offshore Oil Company) — consider recording IOOC as operator.
validity.researcher_notes: OWNER/OPERATOR. GEM Owner='National Iranian Oil Co' 100%, ref=https://www.ioec.com/ioec-at-a-glance. That ref (a) failed to load in the worklist (ConnectTimeout) and (b) is the WRONG entity — ioec.com is IOEC, the Iranian Offshore Engineering & Construction Co (an EPC contractor), not the pipeline owner. The field/pipeline is operated by IOOC (Iranian Offshore Oil Company), a NIOC subsidiary — DMS Universe titles the project 'IOOC - Salman - Sirri Gas Pipeline' and lists Operator=IOOC; petroiran/petro-iran is the field development contractor. NIOC at the parent level is acceptable; IOOC is the precise operating entity. GulfPub also lists operator=NIOC. Swap the ref; optionally set operator=IOOC.

routes.start_name: Salman field KPP production platform (offshore Persian Gulf, ~144 km S of Lavan Island, on the Iran–Abu Dhabi median line)
routes.end_name: Siri (Sirri) Island NGL plant / gas hub
routes.corridor_desc: Subsea gas line running roughly ENE across the Persian Gulf from the Salman field's KPP platform to the NGL/gas-gathering plant on Siri Island, length 145–147 km. End (Siri Island) is precisely known (~25.905N, 54.535E). Start is the Salman field, which straddles the Iran–Abu Dhabi maritime border ~144 km south of Lavan Island; sources give the field area rather than an exact platform coordinate, so start_lat/lon here (~25.55N, 53.3E) is an approximate field-centroid derived from the 'Salman field, ~144 km south of Lavan Island (26.81N)' description — tighten against the actual KPP platform position before use. Straight-line Salman-field→Siri distance (~130–135 km) is consistent with the reported 145–147 km routed length. Corridor is open water; no intermediate land waypoints. NOT the Lavan-Island start currently in the sheet (that is the separate 22-in OIL line).
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints established from independent sources: Salman field/KPP platform (offshore-technology, mizenaft, DMS Universe) → Siri Island NGL plant (offshore-technology explicit). Siri Island coordinate is a well-established real location; Salman start coordinate is a defensible approximate from 'field ~144 km S of Lavan Island', NOT an invented exact platform fix — left as an approximation and flagged. No coordinates fabricated. Corridor is subsea open water so route accuracy realistically caps at 'medium' from public sources without the routes-repo geometry. This is a suggestion for a later human routes-repo branch; do not auto-apply. Note the sheet's current Route start='Asia'/end='Asia' and RouteNotes pointing at the offshore-technology field page are placeholders.

summary: Real, well-corroborated offshore gas feed line (Salman field KPP platform → Siri Island NGL plant, 145–147 km, 30 in, ~160 MMcf/d, op. 2013); confirmed but start endpoint is wrong (sheet says Lavan Island; it is the Salman field) and the owner ref is the wrong entity (IOEC contractor, not IOOC/NIOC).
